user_goal: Discord voice chat with open mic from Switch 2 while playing games; C-button push to talk deferred until accessible.
critical_constraints: Local-only builds via ounce-devkit/devkitPro MSYS2 on Windows
GitHub Desktop pull, double-click Build-NRO.bat, transfer only dist/DiscordNX2.nro via FTP
DO NOT replace /kaihen/plugins/discordnx2.nso or restart kaiHEN during NRO testing
Never use GitHub Actions, Docker or cloud builds
Append changelog, do not erase history
Provide actionable hardware tests, not documentation-only pushes

plugin_status: Existing NSO has diagnostic IPC commands 0,1,2,3 (handshake/status/service-probe/last-probe); no voice capture, PTT, module reload, or Discord connection; plugin cannot be updated without new bootstrap at present.
latest_source_behavior: v0.8 foreground NRO captures 36 x 16 KiB microphone buffers (about 3.07 seconds if all frames succeed)
applies net 1.5x amplitude gain, limits to +/-24000, then plays the delayed recording once with a 7.5s playback wait
logs audio statistics and tests localhost UDP marker loopback, retains plugin persistence checks
no game/voice mixing implemented; no Discord login or C-button support; background NSO untouched
build_validation: v0.7 playback was heard by user on hardware. v0.8 code committed for longer capture and higher playback gain; v0.8 has NOT been built or tested on hardware yet.
key_risks: audout playback may fail despite successful init; bounded wait logs failure and stops output
microphone amplitude has previously been near-silent (peak10) depending on test, possible inactive mic or silence
audio capture buffer waits are bounded; no raw PCM saved
loopback bsd:u may reject socket creation, binding, or localhost delivery
existing README has historical initial setup steps; current v0.7 is NRO-only
no real continuous open mic in background until NSO code extended

discord_integration.constraint: As of March 2026 Discord voice calls require DAVE E2EE; unsupported to claim Opus+simple UDP alone works.
stages: verify spoken-audio playback and continuous capture reliability
build Opus encoding/decoding with compatible local libraries
build secure, supported Discord authentication and gateway flow
implement DAVE-capable voice handshake and RTP/E2EE with secure handling
move tested audio/network engine to resident NSO with safe activation and a mute control
test while game runs, then add C-button only when system input is understood
